text: Israeli settler violence in the occupied West Bank is up 42%, according to a report cited by The New Arab. The period compared is not stated in our record. It follows coordinated settler arson attacks on Palestinian vehicles on 22 Nov.

judge.comment: Figure is second-hand and the comparison period is missing from the tracker data, so a human should check the original report before posting.

factChecks.claim: Settler violence up 42% in the West Bank
Cited by The New Arab
Coordinated settler arson attacks on Palestinian vehicles on 22 Nov
Comparison period not stated

text: How much Russian refining capacity is disabled? Ukraine's General Staff said 42.74% in July 2026. The IEA said losses were 'more than 20%' at peak. Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3-6%. Same strikes, three different measures.

judge.comment: Both sides attributed with sources from the tracker's unresolved disputes; contested type requires human review. The three measures differ in what they count.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine's General Staff put disabled capacity at 42.74% in July 2026
IEA said losses were 'more than 20%' at peak
Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3-6%

text: How many are missing after the Nepal floods? Nepal Police counted 4,718 on 30 Sep, and 5,132 as of 14 Oct. Other compilations range from 5,285 to 6,145, with ~1,000 names added by bookkeeping. No newer official count has been published.

judge.comment: Figures and dates come from the tracker KPIs and disputes; the 'no newer count' claim rests on the Nov 25 digest search, which is not exhaustive.

factChecks.claim: Nepal Police: 4,718 missing on 30 Sep
5,132 missing as of 14 Oct
Other compilations 5,285 to 6,145 missing
No newer official count
factChecks.source: digest says searches surfaced no newer official counts

text: Argentina's Senate voted 43-29 to suspend the 2027 PASO primaries; the bill now goes to the lower house. Congress also gave final approval to Milei's central bank overhaul, which essentially bars the bank from financing government spending.

judge.comment: Two same-day events with concrete figures, matching tracker digest wording.

factChecks.claim: Senate voted 43-29 to suspend 2027 PASO primaries
Bill goes to lower house
Congress gave final approval to central bank overhaul

text: María Corina Machado held her first mass rally since returning from exile, addressing thousands of students at the Universidad Central de Venezuela on 25 Nov. She pledged a transition 'without vengeance' and pressed the interim government to set an election date.

Spoke to thousands of students at UCV on Nov 25
Pledged transition 'without vengeance' and pressed interim government to set election date

text: How many people crossed into Ceuta on 30-31 July? Spain's Interior Ministry first put 24-hour arrivals at roughly 49,000-50,000, later revising to about 72,000 for the full episode. Mayor Juan Jesús Vivas said 60,000 in 24 hours, arguing the government undercounted.

judge.comment: Both sides attributed without adjudication. Contested types never auto-approve; as-of dates are implicit in the July events.

factChecks.claim: Interior Ministry initial 24-hour figure ~49,000-50,000, later ~72,000 for full episode
Mayor Vivas put 24-hour figure at 60,000, argued government undercounted
